summary.zh: 一批快赢改进：仓库详情读取更快（README 提前并行加载 + markdown 后台解析），链接区分站内站外（站外绿色），Release APK 一键直装，文件预览双击全屏，桌面长按快捷方式。
summary.en: A batch of quick wins: faster repo detail (parallel README + off-main markdown parsing), in-app vs external links now color-coded (external green), one-tap APK install from Releases, double-tap fullscreen file preview, and launcher shortcuts.

items.zh: 优化：概览页 README 与仓库信息并行加载，不再串行白等两轮网络；加载中显示骨架屏，不再整块空白
items.en: Overview: README loads in parallel with the repo payload instead of after it, with a skeleton while in flight — no more blank gap

items.zh: 优化：markdown 行内解析（链接/加粗/代码片）移入后台线程，长 README 首屏不再卡顿；卡片渐变等高频重组开销同步削减
items.en: Markdown inline tokenization (links/bold/code chips) moved off the UI thread — long READMEs no longer jank first layout; per-recomposition card allocations trimmed

items.zh: 界面：markdown 链接区分站内/站外——站内保持主题色可跳转 app 内页面，站外绿色，一眼分辨是否离开 GitHub
items.en: Markdown links are color-coded: in-GitHub links keep the theme color and route inside the app, external links render green

items.zh: 新功能：Releases 页点 APK 附件下载完成后自动拉起系统安装器（已缓存则立即安装），不用再绕下载页
items.en: Releases: tapping an .apk asset auto-opens the system installer once downloaded (or immediately if cached) — no detour through Downloads

items.zh: 新功能：代码 tab 文件预览双击进入全屏浏览（文件树默认隐藏，可拖出），工具栏按钮行为不变；图片预览保持单击缩放
items.en: Code tab: double-tap a file preview to jump into the fullscreen viewer (tree hidden by default, draggable back); toolbar button unchanged; images keep single-tap zoom

items.zh: 新功能：桌面长按图标快捷方式——通知、搜索、我的，直达对应页面；顺带修复冷启动深链丢失与带参深链不路由两个问题
items.en: Launcher shortcuts (long-press the icon): Notifications, Search, Profile. Also fixes cold-start deep links being dropped and query-carrying links not routing
